settings.title: Strawberry Cola
settings.ingredients:
2 oz Daytrip Strawberry Amaro
2–3 oz cola
Lemon peel
settings.method: Build over ice, top with cola, express lemon peel.

settings.title: Daytripper
settings.ingredients:
1.5 oz Daytrip Strawberry Amaro
0.25 oz Espadín mezcal
0.75 oz fresh grapefruit juice
0.25 oz simple syrup
settings.method: Shake, strain over rocks and express grapefruit.

settings.title: Strawberry Soda
settings.ingredients:
2 parts Daytrip Strawberry
2 parts soda water
settings.method: Pour over ice, mix, garnish and enjoy. Top with heavy cream for an Italian soda or Prosecco for a spritz.

settings.intro_alt: Daytrip Strawberry Amaro bottle with fresh strawberries
settings.description: A strawberry wine-based amaro that honors the fruit. Real strawberry, lower sugar, no artificial flavoring. A dry, bittersweet finish, with jammy, juicy strawberry notes and hints of gentian, citrus and toasted coconut.
settings.quote_alt: “The Amaro I’ll be drinking all summer” — Sam Stone, Bon Appétit
settings.fact_copy: Wine-based amaro made with real fruit and botanicals
settings.callout_alt: Works in spritzes, Negronis and as a sweet vermouth swap.
